issues.detail: The Greek word 'συνδουλος' (syndoulos) means 'fellow-slave' or 'co-servant,' implying a shared status of servitude/bondage. The Vietnamese translation 'bạn đồng công' translates to 'partner in work' or 'colleague,' which shifts the nuance from shared servitude to professional partnership.

The Greek 'των τηρουντων τους λογους του βιβλιου τουτου' refers to those who 'keep/guard the words of this book.' The Vietnamese translation 'những người giữ các lời của sách này' is mostly accurate, but the Greek phrasing implies a specific role of guarding the words of the book (which is often interpreted as the Law or the Prophets in context), whereas the Vietnamese makes it slightly more general.
